newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks buck trend, shift lower again.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks buck trend, shift lower again.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed lower on Thursday, ignoring gains on Wall Street and other bourses and shifting lower amid losses in key blue chips, dealers said.
The general index fell 1.51 points, 0.33 percent, to 459.49 and the Ibex dropped 23.32 points, 0.44 percent, to 5,256.67.
Repsol shed 140 pesetas to 5,530, correcting after recent gains, after 1996 results met expectations, dealers said.
Endesa also moved significantly lower but in thin volume. The stock fell 140 pesetas 9,120.
BCH rose 140 pesetas to 3,450 after a strong set of 1996 results, in line with forecasts.
Telefonica added 20 pesetas to 3,245 amid the sale of the government's last stake in the firm, and after announcing 1996 results yesterday, which also met market expectations.

"There's no specific reason to justify the investor impasse. Short-term expectations are clearly favourable and although there may be a certain vertigo the stock market should take advantage of the push higher abroad," said one dealer.
The move lower was thus seen as purely technical.
